UN Warns El Niño Could Cause Global Economic Shocks

The United Nations has warned that the El Niño weather phenomenon could act as a 'wrecking ball,' causing widespread havoc across continents and triggering global economic shocks. The phenomenon is also predicted to cause a record rise in Pacific temperatures.
